title: Fatigue Characterization of EEG under Mixed Reality Stereo Vision
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings collected to characterize visual fatigue induced by mixed reality stereo vision. Participants viewed resting and movement scenes designed to elicit varying degrees of visual fatigue while EEG was recorded from 24 scalp electrodes. The dataset supports both resting-state and task-state EEG analyses related to fatigue characterization under stereoscopic visual stimulation.
methods_description: EEG was recorded using 24 electrodes (Fp1, Fp2, AF3, AF4, F7, Fz, F8, FC5, FC6, FT7, FT8, C3, Cz, C4, CP3, CP4, P3, Pz, P4, PO3, PO4, O1, Oz, O2) covering frontal, temporal, central, parietal, and occipital regions. Each participant watched 2 resting scenes and 15 movement scenes in a mixed reality stereo vision setup, followed by a rating scene after each exercise scene. Movement scenes consisted of 20 trials of reciprocal periodic movements at fixed depth and velocity.
